title: Lanzarote Family Escape: 7 Days of Volcanic Wonders & Beach Bliss
description: A week-long family adventure through Lanzarote's surreal volcanic landscapes, golden beaches, and César Manrique's artistic legacy — all on a budget.

days.title: Arrival & Coastal Stroll
days.description: Settle in, stretch your legs along the coast, and enjoy your first Canarian sunset.

activities.name: Arrive at César Manrique Airport (ACE)
activities.description: Pick up your rental car and drive to your accommodation. Costa Teguise and Puerto del Carmen are the best family bases. Stroll along the Charco de San Ginés, a picturesque tidal lagoon in the capital lined with white houses and bobbing fishing boats.

days.title: Fire Mountains & Volcanic Drama
days.description: Experience Lanzarote's most iconic landscape — the surreal lava fields and fire mountains of Timanfaya National Park.

activities.name: Timanfaya National Park
activities.description: Take the guided coach tour through the Montañas del Fuego (Fire Mountains). Watch geothermal demonstrations where water turns to steam and straw ignites from underground heat. Kids love it. Just outside Timanfaya, take a short camel ride across the volcanic terrain. A highlight for kids and adults alike.

activities.name: Explore Yaiza Village
activities.description: One of Spain's prettiest villages — whitewashed houses, bougainvillea, and a peaceful central square. Perfect for a post-lunch wander.

activities.name: El Golfo & Lago Verde
activities.description: Drive to the coast to see the stunning green lagoon (Charco de los Cliclos) inside a half-submerged volcanic crater. Spectacular at sunset.

days.title: Underground Wonders & the Valley of 1000 Palms
days.description: Dive into Lanzarote's volcanic underworld with two spectacular lava tube experiences, then explore the lush north.

activities.name: Jameos del Agua
activities.description: César Manrique transformed this lava tube into a jaw-dropping cultural space with an underground lagoon home to blind albino crabs found nowhere else on Earth. The tropical garden, pool, and auditorium are magical. A guided walk through 1km of a massive lava tube formed 3,000 years ago. Dramatic lighting and a surprise ending that delights everyone.

activities.name: Haría Saturday Market (or town stroll)
activities.description: If it's Saturday, catch the artisan market. Otherwise, wander the charming streets of this palm-filled village, the greenest spot on the island.

activities.name: Mirador del Río
activities.description: Manrique-designed viewpoint perched on 475m cliffs with breathtaking views over La Graciosa island and the strait. The café inside is built into the cliff.

days.title: Art, History & Manrique's Masterpiece
days.description: Explore the island's cultural heart — the old capital of Teguise and the incredible César Manrique Foundation built inside volcanic bubbles.

activities.name: Fundación César Manrique
activities.description: Manrique's former home, built over five volcanic bubbles (jameos). Each bubble is a unique living space — a pool in one, a garden in another. His art collection and the architecture itself are unforgettable.

activities.name: Teguise Old Town
activities.description: The former capital of Lanzarote, with beautiful colonial architecture, churches, and craft shops. If visiting on Sunday, the famous Teguise Market fills the streets with 400+ stalls.

activities.name: Castillo de Santa Bárbara & Piracy Museum
activities.description: Hilltop castle with panoramic views and a quirky museum about the island's history of pirate attacks. Kids find it fascinating.

days.title: Paradise Beaches
days.description: A full beach day at Lanzarote's most stunning coves — the golden Papagayo beaches on the southern tip.

activities.name: Playas de Papagayo
activities.description: A string of pristine golden sand coves with crystal-clear turquoise water, sheltered from the wind. Playa de Papagayo and Playa Mujeres are the standouts. The water is calm and shallow — perfect for kids.

activities.name: Playa Blanca Promenade
activities.description: Head into Playa Blanca town for ice cream and a stroll along the seafront promenade. Browse the shops and enjoy the relaxed southern vibe.

days.title: Wine Country & Surf Town Vibes
days.description: Discover Lanzarote's unique wine-growing region where vines grow in volcanic craters, then enjoy the island's liveliest beach town.

activities.name: La Geria Wine Region
activities.description: Lanzarote's surreal wine valley where each vine is sheltered in a hand-dug pit (hoyo) with a semicircular stone wall. Visit a bodega for a tasting — Malvasía white wine is the local star. Kids can have grape juice and explore the lunar landscape.

activities.name: Monumento al Campesino
activities.description: Another Manrique creation — a striking white sculpture and a small museum/restaurant celebrating Lanzarote's farming heritage. The restaurant serves traditional food cooked over a wood fire.

activities.name: Puerto del Carmen Beaches
activities.description: Hit Playa Grande or Playa Chica for a relaxed afternoon. Playa Chica is a sheltered cove that's great for snorkeling. Puerto del Carmen has the best variety of casual restaurants on the island.

days.title: Surf, Cliffs & Farewell
days.description: End the trip at Lanzarote's most dramatic beach — the wild, windswept Famara with its towering cliffs — before heading to the airport.

activities.name: Playa de Famara
activities.description: A 6km stretch of golden sand backed by 600m cliffs — the most dramatic beach in the Canary Islands. Popular with surfers but the wide sands are perfect for building sandcastles and running around. The views of La Graciosa island are incredible.

activities.name: Jardín de Cactus
activities.description: Manrique's last major work — a beautiful cactus garden built in an old quarry with over 4,500 cacti from around the world. The windmill on top and the café inside are lovely.

activities.name: Departure
activities.description: Return your rental car and head to the airport. ¡Hasta luego, Lanzarote!

editorialSummary: A week-long family adventure through Lanzarote's surreal volcanic landscapes, golden beaches, and César Manrique's artistic legacy — all on a budget.
